text:
Marta (PM): quick design review — noticed the in-console help flyout uses 'Model variant' everywhere but the docs call it 'Pinned model'. which one do we standardize on? Sam (Design): ugh yeah that mismatch causes confusion in the onboarding flows. leaning toward 'Pinned model' since it's clearer to end-users. Kevin (Docs): +1 for 'Pinned model' from docs POV. can we add an alias in the UI like 'Pinned model (aka Model variant)' for the short term? Ava (DevEx): technically fine, but let's avoid long labels in tight UI. maybe show the alias only in the help panel body not the control label. Marta (PM): proposal: keep label 'Pinned model' in controls, and add a short explanatory sentence in the in-product docs panel: "Pinned model (previously "Model variant")". Also we should link to the glossary. Kevin (Docs): I can add a glossary anchor. suggestion for the link: `/docs/glossary#pinned-model` — would that deep link work from the console? Ava (DevEx): yes, deep links are supported. just need to ensure the help panel uses target=_self so it opens in the sidecar. if external, we open new tab. Sam (Design): small UX nit — the help flyout currently truncates long headings. if we add "(previously Model variant)" the layout breaks on mobile. can we show the alias as a tooltip instead on narrow widths? Marta (PM): ok note: tooltip on mobile = bad. alternative: collapse alias into an expandable inline note in the help panel ("why this name?"). keeps control label short. Kevin (Docs): I'll draft the help panel content. minimal copy: "Pinned model: the model version your routes will use. See glossary for full definitions." Also add a crosslink to the rollout docs. Ava (DevEx): crosslink pattern: `/docs/observability/rollouts#model-pinning` — pls use that canonical path. ops-bot: deploy-preview created for docs change at https://deploy-preview/834 Sam (Design): accessibility check: when expanding the inline note, ensure aria-expanded toggles and focus management moves to the content. keyboard users need a clear escape path. Ava (DevEx): agree. add `role=region` and `aria-live=polite` on expansion content so screen readers announce change. Kevin (Docs): Kevin to-Do: add glossary anchor + rollout crosslink + short explainer. ETA EOD tomorrow. Marta (PM): Sam to-Do: update mock with inline collapsible alias; show mobile behavior. ETA Friday. Ava (DevEx): DevEx to-Do: implement deep link behavior and aria attributes, and ensure sidecar doesn't steal focus from top-level route. ETA next Tues. Kevin (Docs): one more copy question — the help panel currently uses the phrase "model pinning" in some places and "pin model" in others. we should settle on one verb form across docs and UI. prefer 'pin model' (action) and 'Pinned model' (state). Sam (Design): agree on verb/state split. I'll audit the UI copy. Marta (PM): final: we standardize on label "Pinned model" for controls, use 'pin model' when referring to the action, add inline collapsible alias in help panel linking to `/docs/glossary#pinned-model`, and ensure a11y with aria-expanded/role=region. thanks all. :sparkles: ops-bot: reminder: design review checklist updated in #design-checks. Kevin (Docs): leaving a note in the docs PR about UI copy sync. Ava (DevEx): leaving a short snippet for engineers: ```html
Previously called "Model variant" — this lets you pin a stable model version to your route. Glossary
``` Marta (PM): perfect. we'll review the PRs together. closing thread after PRs land. :white_check_mark:
